technology.excerpt: With a new Head of Partnerships, a former Microsoft India MD running operations, and Cognizant deploying Claude to 350,000 employees, Anthropic is making its most aggressive push yet into the world's second-largest Claude market.
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers dominate AI research labs globally, and Anthropic's CTO Rahul Patil is of Indian origin. The Bengaluru expansion creates career paths on both sides of the Pacific. For H-1B holders at competing AI companies, Anthropic's India office offers a plan B that keeps them in the same industry.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: C2i Semiconductors Just Taped Out India's First Homegrown AI Power Chip. The Country's Chip Ambitions Just Got Real.
technology.excerpt: A Bengaluru startup backed by Peak XV and TDK Ventures has designed and taped out a smart power stage chip for AI data centres — entirely in India. It is one of the first original semiconductor products to emerge from the country's chip design ecosystem.
technology.nri_angle: Tens of thousands of Indian-origin chip designers work at Intel, Qualcomm, Broadcom and AMD in the US. C2i's tape-out signals that India can originate competitive semiconductor products — not just staff design centres for foreign companies. The return-to-India calculus in semiconductors just shifted.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India Wants 55% of Every Smartphone Made Locally. The Assembly Era Is Over.
technology.excerpt: The government's PLI 2.0 scheme will demand that manufacturers source more than half their components domestically — a sharp escalation that could reshape how Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi operate in the country.
technology.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking India's electronics manufacturing boom face a sharpened thesis: PLI 2.0 tests whether the country can move from assembling iPhones to building the displays, batteries and chips inside them. For Indian-origin supply chain executives at Apple, Foxconn and Samsung, the deeper localisation mandate could create senior roles that did not exist a year ago.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Sundar Pichai Just Shipped a 24/7 AI Agent That Works While You Sleep. It Costs $100 a Month.
technology.excerpt: Gemini Spark, now live for Google AI Ultra subscribers, runs autonomously across Gmail, Docs and the web — even when your phone is off. Built on Gemini 3.5 and Google's Antigravity platform, it is the clearest signal yet that the AI assistant wars have moved from chatbots to autonomous agents.
technology.nri_angle: Google's CEO is Indian-origin. Thousands of Indian engineers at Google built the underlying Gemini models and Antigravity infrastructure. For Indian developers and tech workers in the US, Spark sets the benchmark for what AI agents can do — and raises the bar for what employers will expect from human workers.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu Says Big Tech Is Trading in an 'Insane Bubble.' NRI Portfolios Are Deeply Exposed.
technology.excerpt: India's most prominent bootstrapped tech founder warns that AI-driven valuations — NVIDIA at 20x sales, Apple at 10x — have surpassed dot-com era excess. Separately, he argues AI itself is rapidly commoditising. Both claims land squarely on the Indian American investor class.
technology.nri_angle: Indian Americans are the highest-earning ethnic group in the US and disproportionately concentrated in tech sector stocks — NVIDIA, Apple, Google, Meta. Vembu's bubble warning and his AI commoditisation thesis together challenge the two pillars of NRI tech wealth: equity portfolios and career moats.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: 92,000 Tech Workers Have Lost Their Jobs in 2026. Apple Has Barely Touched Its Workforce.
technology.excerpt: While Meta, Microsoft, and Amazon restructure to fund AI, Apple's disciplined pandemic-era hiring has kept its workforce intact — a distinction that matters enormously to the tens of thousands of Indian H-1B holders caught in the crossfire.
technology.nri_angle: Indians hold roughly three-quarters of all H-1B visas, and tech is the programme's largest employer sector. Every layoff triggers a 60-day grace period — find a new sponsor or leave the country. With the H-1B lottery selection rate at 35% and OPT students reporting zero callbacks after 1,500+ applications, Apple's workforce stability versus competitors' mass layoffs is an existential distinction for diaspora workers.

lifestyle-health.excerpt: Pfizer's BRAFTOVI combination cut the risk of death by 44 per cent in patients with BRAF-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer — a subtype with one of the worst prognoses in oncology.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A 25-Year Study of 32,000 People Found That Quitting Smoking Drops Dementia Risk to the Level of Someone Who Never Smoked.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The benefit kicks in after about seven years smoke-free. For South Asian families where elder male smoking is common, the findings are a wake-up call that it is never too late.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.excerpt: The review, published in Carcinogenesis, examined laboratory, animal, and human studies. The evidence links e-cigarette aerosols to cancers of the lung, mouth, and bladder.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.excerpt: Roads have melted in Delhi. Temperatures hit 50°C. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana account for more than 80 per cent of the dead. Monsoon relief may still be weeks away.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Federal Reserve Report Found That 10 Per Cent of American Households Do Not Have Enough Food. The Number Has Doubled Since 2020.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The savings rate has dropped to 2.6 per cent. More than a third of households are dipping into savings to cover daily expenses. For immigrant families balancing costs across two countries, the squeeze is compounding.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: NRI families face a unique dual-country financial squeeze: rising US costs (gas above $4, food inflation, rents) drain household budgets while remittance obligations to India remain fixed or growing. The savings rate collapse to 2.6% is especially dangerous for families maintaining financial commitments across two economies. Food insecurity compounds pre-existing South Asian cardiovascular and diabetes risks.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A New Class of Cancer Drugs Delivers Radiation Directly to Tumours. ASCO 2026 Data Suggests It Could Replace Chemotherapy for Some Patients.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Radioligand therapies attach radioactive atoms to molecules that seek out cancer cells. The latest results against prostate cancer are the strongest yet — and the field now commands 40 per cent of Novartis's oncology R&D budget.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian men face higher rates of aggressive prostate cancer and tend to present at later stages due to lower screening rates and cultural stigma. Radioligand therapy's targeted, less toxic approach is especially relevant for this population, offering an alternative to chemotherapy with fewer side effects for older patients.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Chinese Cancer Drug Just Beat the Global Gold Standard for Lung Cancer. It Is the First From Asia to Earn a Plenary at ASCO in 61 Years.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Ivonescimab reduced the risk of death by 34 per cent in advanced squamous lung cancer. The results were published in The Lancet the same day. For Indian families watching air-pollution-driven cancer rates climb, the implications are significant.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: The WHO Just Endorsed a $1 Antibiotic Pill That Prevents Syphilis and Chlamydia After Sex. It Is Their First Recommendation of Its Kind.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis can reduce syphilis and chlamydia by up to 80 per cent. With STI rates rising sharply in India and across the diaspora, the decision could reshape sexual health prevention worldwide.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: South Asian Adults in the US Have 30 Per Cent Prediabetes by Age 45. They Also Report the Healthiest Diets. A Major Study Says the Paradox Is Real.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The MASALA study followed 2,700 adults for a decade and found that South Asians develop cardiovascular risk factors earlier than every other ethnic group — despite doing many of the right things.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new JAMA Pediatrics study found that 50 per cent of American teenagers spend up to an hour on their phones between 10 PM and 6 AM on school nights. The federal advisory calls for immediate parental action.
